purpose.domain_detail: Italian life insurance portfolio system ('Portafoglio Vita Italia'). This is a service subprogram that retrieves and converts a policy inception date (data decorrenza polizza) by calling LDBS2910.
purpose.summary: Subprogram LVVS0092 is a service routine in an Italian life insurance system. It initializes working areas, distributes input DCLGEN data into working storage, then calls LDBS2910 to retrieve the policy start date (PRSTZ-INI-NEWFIS) and returns it in the output area. Error handling covers not-found, null (-305), and general SQL/call errors.

notable_features: Dynamic CALL via data item WK-CALL-PGM
STRING ... DELIMITED BY SIZE for error message construction
Multiple COPY books: LDBV2911, LCCVPOL1, IVVC0218, IDSV0002, IDSV0003, IVVC0213
PERFORM VARYING with multiple UNTIL conditions
verdict.notes: Program header says LVVS0007 in comments but PROGRAM-ID is LVVS0092 — likely a copy-paste artifact in the comment block. No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS present; DB2 interaction is delegated to called subprogram LDBS2910. Italian-language comments and variable names confirm Italian insurance domain context.
